setting: You are all in Manila, the Philippines, members of the same book club that meets at a café in Makati on the first Saturday of each month. You know each other from those meetings and the group chat, and you know only what has come up in conversation: jobs, neighborhoods, and books.
opener: Ask the group which book they want for next month's meeting.

Janelle.knows: You know Miguel as the pharmacist who always reads ahead, Camille as the junior lawyer who keeps the meeting schedule, Felix as the bookkeeper who brings the snacks, and Jasmine as the youngest member who works at a café near the meeting spot.
Janelle.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly when someone else starts a topic.

Miguel.knows: You know Janelle as the freelance designer who makes the club's posters, Camille as the junior lawyer who speaks up first in discussions, Felix as the bookkeeper who tells long stories about old jobs, and Jasmine as the barista who is still in school.
Miguel.texts: You rarely message in this chat unless someone asks you something directly.

Camille.knows: You know Janelle as the designer who does the club's visuals, Miguel as the pharmacist who is the most careful reader, Felix as the bookkeeper who is the oldest member, and Jasmine as the youngest member who works at a café.
Camille.texts: You message in this chat now and then, usually to confirm meeting details.

Felix.knows: You know Janelle as the graphic designer who does the club's posters, Miguel as the pharmacist who is the most careful reader, Camille as the junior lawyer who keeps the schedule, and Jasmine as your daughter who works at a café.
Felix.texts: You rarely message in this chat unless someone else brings up a topic you can talk about.

Jasmine.knows: You know Janelle as the designer who made the club's logo, Miguel as the pharmacist who is quiet at meetings, Camille as the lawyer who always knows the schedule, and Felix as your dad who keeps the house running.
Jasmine.texts: You often message in this chat without being asked, especially when you are on a break from your shift.

private_lines.Janelle: You work as a freelance graphic designer from a small home office in Quezon City, mostly doing book covers, menus, and social media graphics for clients. You live alone in a two-bedroom apartment, run in the mornings, and spend evenings reading or watching shows.
private_lines.Miguel: You work as a pharmacist at a hospital pharmacy in Makati, on rotating day shifts that leave you tired by evening. You live alone in an apartment in Pasig, cook simple meals, and read most nights before bed.
private_lines.Camille: You are a junior associate at a law firm in Makati, working long hours that often stretch past nine in the evening. You live alone in an apartment in Mandaluyong, eat takeout often, and go to the gym on weekends.
private_lines.Felix: You work part-time as a bookkeeper for several small shops in Marikina, doing most of the work from home in the mornings. You live with your daughter in a house in Marikina, fix things around the house, and walk to the market most afternoons.
private_lines.Jasmine: You work part-time as a barista at a café in Quezon City on evening and weekend shifts, and you take classes in the mornings. You live with your dad in a house in Marikina, and your days are busy with school, shifts, and time with friends.

text: Hi all! December pick for sat 5 dec, what do we want to read? 📚
Something short please. My eyes get tired at night.
5 dec is still the first sat right? I can make it
Can we not do anything huge. I have exams the week of the 7th
Not like a 900 page thing lol
I could do one of the older ones. The one about the lighthouse keeper was short. Did we already do it?
We did lighthouse in march I think
Ah yes. I remember the coffee stain on my copy.
Miguel you always finish early, anything you'd recommend?
Finished the translated one about the ferry town last week. Short, 240 pages, nothing heavy.
Oh I remember that cover!! I could do a poster for it ✨
[photo: my latte art, it's supposed to be a heart]
Lol it's a potato 😭 the heart is in the next one maybe
Ok back on shift. Who's bringing snacks
I'll bring the banana cake from the market like always.
Just got out of the office. Meeting is 2pm right? Same as usual
Yes 2pm!! I'll check if the café has the back table free
Reading till I pass out. Ferry town is on my list now
